verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּעֵ֖בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן בַּמִּדְבָּ֡ר בָּֽעֲרָבָה֩ מ֨וֹל ס֜וּף בֵּֽין־ פָּארָ֧ן וּבֵֽין־ תֹּ֛פֶל וְלָבָ֥ן וַחֲצֵרֹ֖ת וְדִ֥י זָהָֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer dib·ber mō·šeh ’el- kāl- yiś·rā·’êl bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên bam·miḏ·bār bā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh mō·wl sūp̄ bên- pā·rān ū·ḇên- tō·p̄el wə·lā·ḇān wa·ḥă·ṣê·rōṯ wə·ḏî zā·hāḇ
verses.literal: These are the words that Moses spoke to all Israel in the wilderness east of the Jordan in the Arabah opposite Suph between Paran . . . and Tophel Laban Hazeroth and Dizahab
verses.literalPt: Estas são as palavras que Moisés falou a todo o Israel além do Jordão, no deserto, na Arabá, defronte de Sufe, entre Parã, Tofel, Labã, Hazerote e Di-Zaabe.

verses.original: אַחַ֨ד עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ מֵֽחֹרֵ֔ב דֶּ֖רֶךְ הַר־ שֵׂעִ֑יר עַ֖ד קָדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥaḏ ‘ā·śār yō·wm mê·ḥō·rêḇ de·reḵ har- śê·‘îr ‘aḏ qā·ḏêš bar·nê·a‘
verses.literal: It is an eleven-day . . . . . . journey from Horeb to Kadesh-barnea by way of Mount Seir
verses.literalPt: É viagem de onze dias desde Horebe, pelo caminho do monte Seir, até Cades-Barneia.

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ בְּאַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּעַשְׁתֵּֽי־ עָשָׂ֥ר חֹ֖דֶשׁ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ דִּבֶּ֤ר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹת֖וֹ אֲלֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh bə·‘aš·tê- ‘ā·śār ḥō·ḏeš bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš dib·ber mō·šeh ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’ō·ṯōw ’ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: In the fortieth year on the first day . . . of the eleventh . . . month Moses proclaimed to the Israelites . . . all that the LORD had commanded him concerning them
verses.literalPt: No ano quadragésimo, no undécimo mês, no primeiro dia do mês, falou Moisés aos filhos de Israel conforme tudo o que Jeová lhe havia ordenado com relação a eles,

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֣י הַכֹּת֗וֹ אֵ֚ת סִיחֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן וְאֵ֗ת ע֚וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁר־ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּעַשְׁתָּרֹ֖ת בְּאֶדְרֶֽעִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê hak·kō·ṯōw ’êṯ sî·ḥōn me·leḵ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer yō·wō·šêḇ bə·ḥeš·bō·wn wə·’êṯ ‘ō·wḡ me·leḵ hab·bā·šān ’ă·šer- yō·wō·šêḇ bə·‘aš·tā·rōṯ bə·’eḏ·re·‘î
verses.literal: This was after he had defeated Sihon king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon and then at Edrei had defeated Og king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth
verses.literalPt: depois de ter derrotado a Seom, rei dos amorreus, que habitava em Hesbom, e a Ogue, rei de Basã, que habitava em Astarote, em Edrei.

verses.original: בְּעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מוֹאָ֑ב הוֹאִ֣יל מֹשֶׁ֔ה בֵּאֵ֛ר אֶת־ הַתּוֹרָ֥ה הַזֹּ֖את לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên bə·’e·reṣ mō·w·’āḇ hō·w·’îl mō·šeh bê·’êr ’eṯ- hat·tō·w·rāh haz·zōṯ lê·mōr
verses.literal: On the east side of the Jordan in the land of Moab Moses began to explain this law saying
verses.literalPt: Além do Jordão, na terra de Moabe, resolveu Moisés explicar esta lei, dizendo:

verses.original: יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ דִּבֶּ֥ר אֵלֵ֖ינוּ בְּחֹרֵ֣ב לֵאמֹ֑ר רַב־ לָכֶ֥ם שֶׁ֖בֶת בָּהָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū dib·ber ’ê·lê·nū bə·ḥō·rêḇ lê·mōr raḇ- lā·ḵem še·ḇeṯ bā·hār haz·zeh
verses.literal: The LORD our God said to us at Horeb You have stayed at this mountain long enough
verses.literalPt: Jeová, nosso Deus, falou-nos em Horebe: Assaz vos tendes demorado neste monte.

verses.original: פְּנ֣וּ׀ וּסְע֣וּ לָכֶ֗ם וּבֹ֨אוּ הַ֥ר הָֽאֱמֹרִי֮ וְאֶל־ כָּל־ שְׁכֵנָיו֒ בָּעֲרָבָ֥ה בָהָ֛ר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָ֥ה וּבַנֶּ֖גֶב וּבְח֣וֹף הַיָּ֑ם אֶ֤רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְהַלְּבָנ֔וֹן עַד־ הַנָּהָ֥ר הַגָּדֹ֖ל נְהַר־ פְּרָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: pə·nū ū·sə·‘ū lā·ḵem ū·ḇō·’ū har hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·’el- kāl- šə·ḵê·nāw bā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh ḇā·hār ū·ḇaš·šə·p̄ê·lāh ū·ḇan·ne·ḡeḇ ū·ḇə·ḥō·wp̄ hay·yām ’e·reṣ hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî wə·hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn ‘aḏ- han·nā·hār hag·gā·ḏōl nə·har- pə·rāṯ
verses.literal: Resume your journey and go to the hill country of the Amorites go to all the neighboring peoples in the Arabah in the hill country in the foothills in the Negev and along the seacoast . . . to the land of the Canaanites and to Lebanon as far as the great River Euphrates
verses.literalPt: Voltai, ponde-vos a caminho e ide à região montanhosa dos amorreus e a todos os lugares vizinhos da Arabá, da região montanhosa, da Sefelá, do Neguebe, da costa marítima, terra dos cananeus e do Líbano, até o grande rio, o rio Eufrates.

verses.original: רְאֵ֛ה נָתַ֥תִּי לִפְנֵיכֶ֖ם אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ בֹּ֚אוּ וּרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבַּ֣ע יְ֠הוָה לַאֲבֹ֨תֵיכֶ֜ם לְאַבְרָהָ֨ם לְיִצְחָ֤ק וּֽלְיַעֲקֹב֙ לָתֵ֣ת לָהֶ֔ם וּלְזַרְעָ֖ם אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh nā·ṯat·tî lip̄·nê·ḵem ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ bō·’ū ū·rə·šū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer niš·ba‘ Yah·weh la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem lə·’aḇ·rā·hām lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ū·lə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ lā·ṯêṯ lā·hem ū·lə·zar·‘ām ’a·ḥă·rê·hem
verses.literal: See I have placed the land before you Enter and possess the land that the LORD swore He would give to your fathers Abraham Isaac and Jacob and to their descendants after them
verses.literalPt: Eis que vos entreguei esta terra; entrai e possuí a terra que Jeová prometeu com juramento a vossos pais, a Abraão, a Isaque e a Jacó, a eles e à sua semente depois deles.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֣ר אֲלֵכֶ֔ם בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹא־ אוּכַ֥ל לְבַדִּ֖י שְׂאֵ֥ת אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ă·lê·ḵem bā·‘êṯ ha·hi·w lê·mōr lō- ’ū·ḵal lə·ḇad·dî śə·’êṯ ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: At that . . . time I said to you I cannot . . . carry the burden for you alone
verses.literalPt: Eu vos disse nesse tempo: Não posso sozinho levar-vos;

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶ֖ם הִרְבָּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֑ם וְהִנְּכֶ֣ם הַיּ֔וֹם כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם לָרֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem hir·bāh ’eṯ·ḵem wə·hin·nə·ḵem hay·yō·wm kə·ḵō·wḵ·ḇê haš·šā·ma·yim lā·rōḇ
verses.literal: The LORD your God has multiplied you so that today you are as numerous as the stars in the sky
verses.literalPt: Jeová, vosso Deus, vos tem multiplicado, e em multidão sois hoje como as estrelas do céu.

verses.original: יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבֽוֹתֵכֶ֗ם יֹסֵ֧ף עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם כָּכֶ֖ם אֶ֣לֶף פְּעָמִ֑ים וִיבָרֵ֣ךְ אֶתְכֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem yō·sêp̄ ‘ă·lê·ḵem kā·ḵem ’e·lep̄ pə·‘ā·mîm wî·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ·ḵem ka·’ă·šer dib·ber lā·ḵem
verses.literal: May the LORD the God of your fathers increase you . . . a thousand times over and bless you as He has promised
verses.literalPt: Jeová, Deus de vossos pais, vos faça mil vezes mais numerosos do que sois e vos abençoe, como vos prometeu.

verses.original: אֵיכָ֥ה אֶשָּׂ֖א לְבַדִּ֑י טָרְחֲכֶ֥ם וּמַֽשַּׂאֲכֶ֖ם וְרִֽיבְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·ḵāh ’eś·śā lə·ḇad·dî ṭā·rə·ḥă·ḵem ū·maś·śa·’ă·ḵem wə·rî·ḇə·ḵem
verses.literal: But how can I bear your troubles burdens and disputes all by myself
verses.literalPt: Como posso sozinho levar o vosso peso, a vossa carga e a vossa contenda?

verses.original: הָב֣וּ לָ֠כֶם אֲנָשִׁ֨ים חֲכָמִ֧ים וּנְבֹנִ֛ים וִידֻעִ֖ים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶ֑ם וַאֲשִׂימֵ֖ם בְּרָאשֵׁיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hā·ḇū lā·ḵem ’ă·nā·šîm ḥă·ḵā·mîm ū·nə·ḇō·nîm wî·ḏu·‘îm lə·šiḇ·ṭê·ḵem wa·’ă·śî·mêm bə·rā·šê·ḵem
verses.literal: Choose for yourselves wise understanding and respected men from each of your tribes and I will appoint them as your leaders
verses.literalPt: Tomai-vos homens sábios, e entendidos, e experimentados, segundo as vossas tribos, e pô-los-ei por cabeças sobre vós.

verses.original: וַֽתַּעֲנ֖וּ אֹתִ֑י וַתֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ טֽוֹב־ הַדָּבָ֥ר אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘ă·nū ’ō·ṯî wat·tō·mə·rū ṭō·wḇ- had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- dib·bar·tā la·‘ă·śō·wṯ
verses.literal: And you answered me and said What you propose to do is good . . .
verses.literalPt: Respondestes-me: É bom fazer o que disseste.

verses.original: וָאֶקַּ֞ח אֶת־ רָאשֵׁ֣י שִׁבְטֵיכֶ֗ם אֲנָשִׁ֤ים חֲכָמִים֙ וִֽידֻעִ֔ים וָאֶתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛ם רָאשִׁ֖ים עֲלֵיכֶ֑ם שָׂרֵ֨י אֲלָפִ֜ים וְשָׂרֵ֣י מֵא֗וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֤י חֲמִשִּׁים֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י עֲשָׂרֹ֔ת וְשֹׁטְרִ֖ים לְשִׁבְטֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eq·qaḥ ’eṯ- rā·šê šiḇ·ṭê·ḵem ’ă·nā·šîm ḥă·ḵā·mîm wî·ḏu·‘îm wā·’et·tên ’ō·ṯām rā·šîm ‘ă·lê·ḵem śā·rê ’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·śā·rê mê·’ō·wṯ wə·śā·rê ḥă·miš·šîm wə·śā·rê ‘ă·śā·rōṯ wə·šō·ṭə·rîm lə·šiḇ·ṭê·ḵem
verses.literal: So I took the leaders of your tribes wise and respected men and appointed them as leaders over you as commanders of thousands . . . of hundreds . . . of fifties . . . and of tens and as officers for your tribes
verses.literalPt: Tomei, pois, os cabeças das vossas tribos, homens sábios e entendidos e fi-los cabeças sobre vós, capitães de mil, capitães de cem, e capitães de cinquenta, e capitães de dez, e oficiais, segundo as vossas tribos.

verses.original: וָאֲצַוֶּה֙ אֶת־ שֹׁ֣פְטֵיכֶ֔ם בָּעֵ֥ת הַהִ֖וא לֵאמֹ֑ר שָׁמֹ֤עַ בֵּין־ אֲחֵיכֶם֙ וּשְׁפַטְתֶּ֣ם צֶ֔דֶק בֵּֽין־ אִ֥ישׁ וּבֵין־ אָחִ֖יו וּבֵ֥ין גֵּרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ă·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ- šō·p̄ə·ṭê·ḵem bā·‘êṯ ha·hi·w lê·mōr šā·mō·a‘ bên- ’ă·ḥê·ḵem ū·šə·p̄aṭ·tem ṣe·ḏeq bên- ’îš ū·ḇên- ’ā·ḥîw ū·ḇên gê·rōw
verses.literal: At that . . . time I charged your judges Hear the disputes between your brothers and judge fairly between a man . . . and his brother . . . or a foreign resident
verses.literalPt: Mandei aos vossos juízes nesse tempo, dizendo: Ouvi as causas entre vossos irmãos e julgai com justiça entre um homem e seu irmão ou o estrangeiro que está com ele.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תַכִּ֨ירוּ פָנִ֜ים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֗ט כַּקָּטֹ֤ן כַּגָּדֹל֙ תִּשְׁמָע֔וּן לֹ֤א תָג֙וּרוּ֙ מִפְּנֵי־ אִ֔ישׁ כִּ֥י הַמִּשְׁפָּ֖ט לֵאלֹהִ֣ים ה֑וּא וְהַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִקְשֶׁ֣ה מִכֶּ֔ם תַּקְרִב֥וּן אֵלַ֖י וּשְׁמַעְתִּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯak·kî·rū p̄ā·nîm bam·miš·pāṭ kaq·qā·ṭōn kag·gā·ḏōl tiš·mā·‘ūn lō ṯā·ḡū·rū mip·pə·nê- ’îš kî ham·miš·pāṭ lê·lō·hîm hū wə·had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer yiq·šeh mik·kem taq·ri·ḇūn ’ê·lay ū·šə·ma‘·tîw
verses.literal: Show no partiality . . . in judging hear both small and great alike Do not be intimidated by anyone for judgment belongs to God . . . And bring to me any case too difficult for you and I will hear it
verses.literalPt: Ao julgardes, não vos deixareis levar de respeitos humanos. Do mesmo modo, ouvireis o pequeno como o grande; não temereis o rosto de homem algum, porque o juízo é de Deus. A causa que for demasiado difícil para vós, a trareis para mim, e ouvi-la-ei.

verses.original: וָאֲצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑וא אֵ֥ת כָּל־ הַדְּבָרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֽׂוּן׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ă·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ·ḵem bā·‘êṯ ha·hi·w ’êṯ kāl- had·də·ḇā·rîm ’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śūn
verses.literal: And at that time I commanded you all the things you were to do
verses.literalPt: Ordenei-vos nesse tempo tudo o que deveis fazer.

verses.original: וַנִּסַּ֣ע מֵחֹרֵ֗ב וַנֵּ֡לֶךְ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַמִּדְבָּ֣ר הַגָּדוֹל֩ וְהַנּוֹרָ֨א הַה֜וּא אֲשֶׁ֣ר רְאִיתֶ֗ם דֶּ֚רֶךְ הַ֣ר הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֛ה יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ אֹתָ֑נוּ וַנָּבֹ֕א עַ֖ד קָדֵ֥שׁ בַּרְנֵֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wan·nis·sa‘ mê·ḥō·rêḇ wan·nê·leḵ ’êṯ kāl- ham·miḏ·bār hag·gā·ḏō·wl wə·han·nō·w·rā ha·hū ’ă·šer rə·’î·ṯem de·reḵ har hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ka·’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū ’ō·ṯā·nū wan·nā·ḇō ‘aḏ qā·ḏêš bar·nê·a‘
verses.literal: And just as the LORD our God had commanded us we set out from Horeb and went toward the hill country of the Amorites through all the vast and terrifying . . . wilderness you have seen When we reached . . . Kadesh-barnea
verses.literalPt: Tendo partido de Horebe, passamos por todo aquele grande e medonho deserto que vistes, no caminho da região montanhosa dos amorreus, como Jeová, nosso Deus, nos ordenou; e chegamos a Cades-Barneia.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֖ר אֲלֵכֶ֑ם בָּאתֶם֙ עַד־ הַ֣ר הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ă·lê·ḵem bā·ṯem ‘aḏ- har hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū nō·ṯên lā·nū
verses.literal: I said You have reached . . . the hill country of the Amorites which the LORD our God is giving us
verses.literalPt: Então, eu vos disse: Sois chegados à região montanhosa dos amorreus, a qual Jeová, nosso Deus, nos está dando.

verses.original: רְ֠אֵה נָתַ֨ן יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ לְפָנֶ֖יךָ אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ עֲלֵ֣ה רֵ֗שׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבֶּ֨ר יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י אֲבֹתֶ֙יךָ֙ לָ֔ךְ אַל־ תִּירָ֖א וְאַל־ תֵּחָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh nā·ṯan Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ‘ă·lêh rêš ka·’ă·šer dib·ber Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā lāḵ ’al- tî·rā wə·’al- tê·ḥāṯ
verses.literal: See the LORD your God has placed the land before you Go up and take possession of it as the LORD the God of your fathers has told you Do not be afraid . . . or discouraged
verses.literalPt: Eis que Jeová, teu Deus, te entregou a terra; sobe e toma posse dela, como te prometeu Jeová, Deus de teus pais; não temas, nem te assustes.

verses.original: וַתִּקְרְב֣וּן אֵלַי֮ כֻּלְּכֶם֒ וַתֹּאמְר֗וּ נִשְׁלְחָ֤ה אֲנָשִׁים֙ לְפָנֵ֔ינוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ־ לָ֖נוּ אֶת־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וְיָשִׁ֤בוּ אֹתָ֙נוּ֙ דָּבָ֔ר אֶת־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲלֶה־ בָּ֔הּ וְאֵת֙ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָבֹ֖א אֲלֵיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·rə·ḇūn ’ê·lay kul·lə·ḵem wat·tō·mə·rū niš·lə·ḥāh ’ă·nā·šîm lə·p̄ā·nê·nū wə·yaḥ·pə·rū- lā·nū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·yā·ši·ḇū ’ō·ṯā·nū dā·ḇār ’eṯ- had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer na·‘ă·leh- bāh wə·’êṯ he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer nā·ḇō ’ă·lê·hen
verses.literal: Then all of you approached me and said Let us send men ahead of us to search out the land and bring us word of what route to follow and which cities to enter . . .
verses.literalPt: Então, todos vós chegastes a mim e dissestes: Enviemos homens adiante de nós, que nos espiem a terra e nos ensinem o caminho por que devemos subir e as cidades a que devemos ir.

verses.original: וַיִּיטַ֥ב בְּעֵינַ֖י הַדָּבָ֑ר וָאֶקַּ֤ח מִכֶּם֙ שְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֣ר אֲנָשִׁ֔ים אִ֥ישׁ אֶחָ֖ד לַשָּֽׁבֶט׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·ṭaḇ bə·‘ê·nay had·dā·ḇār wā·’eq·qaḥ mik·kem šə·nêm ‘ā·śār ’ă·nā·šîm ’îš ’e·ḥāḏ laš·šā·ḇeṭ
verses.literal: The plan seemed good to me so I selected twelve . . . . . . men from among you one from each tribe
verses.literalPt: Isso me pareceu bem, e tomei doze homens dentre vós, um homem de cada tribo;

verses.original: וַיִּפְנוּ֙ וַיַּעֲל֣וּ הָהָ֔רָה וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ עַד־ נַ֣חַל אֶשְׁכֹּ֑ל וַֽיְרַגְּל֖וּ אֹתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·nū way·ya·‘ă·lū hā·hā·rāh way·yā·ḇō·’ū ‘aḏ- na·ḥal ’eš·kōl way·rag·gə·lū ’ō·ṯāh
verses.literal: They left and went up into the hill country and came to the Valley of Eshcol and spied out the land
verses.literalPt: eles, tendo-se posto a caminho, subiram a região montanhosa, e chegaram ao vale de Escol, e espiaram a terra.

verses.original: וַיִּקְח֤וּ בְיָדָם֙ מִפְּרִ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיּוֹרִ֖דוּ אֵלֵ֑ינוּ וַיָּשִׁ֨בוּ אֹתָ֤נוּ דָבָר֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ טוֹבָ֣ה הָאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ נֹתֵ֥ן לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū ḇə·yā·ḏām mip·pə·rî hā·’ā·reṣ way·yō·w·ri·ḏū ’ê·lê·nū way·yā·ši·ḇū ’ō·ṯā·nū ḏā·ḇār way·yō·mə·rū ṭō·w·ḇāh hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū nō·ṯên lā·nū
verses.literal: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands carried it down to us and brought us word . . . It is a good land that the LORD our God is giving us
verses.literalPt: Tendo tomado do fruto da terra nas mãos, no-lo trouxeram e nos informaram, dizendo: É terra boa a que Jeová, nosso Deus, nos está dando.

verses.original: וְלֹ֥א אֲבִיתֶ֖ם לַעֲלֹ֑ת וַתַּמְר֕וּ אֶת־ פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ’ă·ḇî·ṯem la·‘ă·lōṯ wat·tam·rū ’eṯ- pî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: But you were unwilling . . . to go up you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Porém não quisestes subir e fostes rebeldes à ordem de Jeová, vosso Deus.

verses.original: וַתֵּרָגְנ֤וּ בְאָהֳלֵיכֶם֙ וַתֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ בְּשִׂנְאַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ אֹתָ֔נוּ הוֹצִיאָ֖נוּ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם לָתֵ֥ת אֹתָ֛נוּ בְּיַ֥ד הָאֱמֹרִ֖י לְהַשְׁמִידֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·rā·ḡə·nū ḇə·’ā·ho·lê·ḵem wat·tō·mə·rū bə·śin·’aṯ Yah·weh ’ō·ṯā·nū hō·w·ṣî·’ā·nū mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim lā·ṯêṯ ’ō·ṯā·nū bə·yaḏ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî lə·haš·mî·ḏê·nū
verses.literal: You grumbled in your tents and said . . . Because the LORD hates us He has brought us out of the land of Egypt to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to be annihilated
verses.literalPt: Murmurastes nas vossas tendas e dissestes: Porque Jeová nos odiou, tirou-nos da terra do Egito, para nos entregar nas mãos dos amorreus, a fim de nos destruir.

verses.original: אָנָ֣ה׀ אֲנַ֣חְנוּ עֹלִ֗ים אַחֵינוּ֩ הֵמַ֨סּוּ אֶת־ לְבָבֵ֜נוּ לֵאמֹ֗ר עַ֣ם גָּד֤וֹל וָרָם֙ מִמֶּ֔נּוּ עָרִ֛ים גְּדֹלֹ֥ת וּבְצוּרֹ֖ת בַּשָּׁמָ֑יִם וְגַם־ בְּנֵ֥י עֲנָקִ֖ים רָאִ֥ינוּ שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nāh ’ă·naḥ·nū ‘ō·lîm ’a·ḥê·nū hê·mas·sū ’eṯ- lə·ḇā·ḇê·nū lê·mōr ‘am gā·ḏō·wl wā·rām mim·men·nū ‘ā·rîm gə·ḏō·lōṯ ū·ḇə·ṣū·rōṯ baš·šā·mā·yim wə·ḡam- bə·nê ‘ă·nā·qîm rā·’î·nū šām
verses.literal: Where can we go Our brothers have made our hearts melt - saying The people are larger and taller than we are the cities are large with walls up to the heavens We even saw the descendants of the Anakim there
verses.literalPt: Para onde estamos nós subindo? Nossos irmãos fizeram que se derretesse nosso coração, dizendo: O povo é maior e mais alto do que nós, as cidades são grandes e fortificadas até o céu. Também vimos ali os filhos dos anaquins.

verses.original: וָאֹמַ֖ר אֲלֵכֶ֑ם לֹא־ תַֽעַרְצ֥וּן וְֽלֹא־ תִֽירְא֖וּן מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·mar ’ă·lê·ḵem lō- ṯa·‘ar·ṣūn wə·lō- ṯî·rə·’ūn mê·hem
verses.literal: So I said to you Do not be terrified . . . or afraid of them
verses.literalPt: Então, eu vos disse: Não tremais, nem tenhais medo deles.

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶם֙ הַהֹלֵ֣ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם ה֖וּא יִלָּחֵ֣ם לָכֶ֑ם כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֧ה אִתְּכֶ֛ם בְּמִצְרַ֖יִם לְעֵינֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem ha·hō·lêḵ lip̄·nê·ḵem hū yil·lā·ḥêm lā·ḵem kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh ’it·tə·ḵem bə·miṣ·ra·yim lə·‘ê·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: The LORD your God who goes before you . . . will fight for you just as you saw Him do for you in Egypt
verses.literalPt: Jeová, vosso Deus, que vai adiante de vós, ele mesmo pelejará por vós, segundo tudo o que fez por vós no Egito, diante dos vossos olhos;

verses.original: וּבַמִּדְבָּר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֔יתָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נְשָׂאֲךָ֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשָּׂא־ אִ֖ישׁ אֶת־ בְּנ֑וֹ בְּכָל־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הֲלַכְתֶּ֔ם עַד־ בֹּאֲכֶ֖ם עַד־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇam·miḏ·bār ’ă·šer rā·’î·ṯā ’ă·šer nə·śā·’ă·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ka·’ă·šer yiś·śā- ’îš ’eṯ- bə·nōw bə·ḵāl had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer hă·laḵ·tem ‘aḏ- bō·’ă·ḵem ‘aḏ- ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: and in the wilderness where the LORD your God carried you as a man carries his son all the way by which you traveled until you reached . . . this place
verses.literalPt: e no deserto, em que vistes como Jeová, vosso Deus, vos levou, como um homem leva a seu filho, em todo o caminho por que andastes, até chegardes a este lugar.

verses.original: וּבַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּ֑ה אֵֽינְכֶם֙ מַאֲמִינִ֔ם בַּיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇad·dā·ḇār haz·zeh ’ê·nə·ḵem ma·’ă·mî·nim Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: But in spite of all this you did not trust the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Apesar disso, continuastes descrendo a Jeová, vosso Deus,

verses.original: הַהֹלֵ֨ךְ לִפְנֵיכֶ֜ם בַּדֶּ֗רֶךְ לָת֥וּר לָכֶ֛ם מָק֖וֹם לַֽחֲנֹֽתְכֶ֑ם בָּאֵ֣שׁ׀ לַ֗יְלָה לַרְאֹֽתְכֶם֙ בַּדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽלְכוּ־ בָ֔הּ וּבֶעָנָ֖ן יוֹמָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hō·lêḵ lip̄·nê·ḵem bad·de·reḵ lā·ṯūr lā·ḵem mā·qō·wm la·ḥă·nō·ṯə·ḵem bā·’êš lay·lāh lar·’ō·ṯə·ḵem bad·de·reḵ ’ă·šer tê·lə·ḵū- ḇāh ū·ḇe·‘ā·nān yō·w·mām
verses.literal: who went before you on the journey in the fire by night and in the cloud by day to seek out a place for you to camp and to show you the road to travel
verses.literalPt: que foi adiante de vós no caminho, para vos procurar o lugar em que devíeis acampar: de noite no fogo, para vos mostrar o caminho por onde devíeis andar, e de dia na nuvem.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ ק֣וֹל דִּבְרֵיכֶ֑ם וַיִּקְצֹ֖ף וַיִּשָּׁבַ֥ע לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ Yah·weh ’eṯ- qō·wl diḇ·rê·ḵem way·yiq·ṣōp̄ way·yiš·šā·ḇa‘ lê·mōr
verses.literal: When the LORD - heard your words He grew angry and swore an oath saying
verses.literalPt: Tendo Jeová, pois, ouvido a voz das vossas palavras, indignou-se e jurou, dizendo:

verses.original: אִם־ יִרְאֶ֥ה אִישׁ֙ בָּאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה הַדּ֥וֹר הָרָ֖ע הַזֶּ֑ה אֵ֚ת הָאָ֣רֶץ הַטּוֹבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִשְׁבַּ֔עְתִּי לָתֵ֖ת לַאֲבֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yir·’eh ’îš bā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl·leh had·dō·wr hā·rā‘ haz·zeh ’êṯ hā·’ā·reṣ haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇāh ’ă·šer niš·ba‘·tî lā·ṯêṯ la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: Not one of the men of this evil generation shall see the good land I swore to give your fathers
verses.literalPt: Certamente, nenhum destes homens, esta geração perversa, verá a boa terra que prometi, com juramento, dar a vossos pais,

verses.original: זֽוּלָתִ֞י כָּלֵ֤ב בֶּן־ יְפֻנֶּה֙ ה֣וּא יִרְאֶ֔נָּה וְלֽוֹ־ אֶתֵּ֧ן אֶת־ הָאָ֛רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר דָּֽרַךְ־ בָּ֖הּ וּלְבָנָ֑יו יַ֕עַן אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִלֵּ֖א אַחֲרֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: zū·lā·ṯî kā·lêḇ ben- yə·p̄un·neh hū yir·’en·nāh wə·lōw- ’et·tên ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer dā·raḵ- bāh ū·lə·ḇā·nāw ya·‘an ’ă·šer mil·lê ’a·ḥă·rê Yah·weh
verses.literal: except Caleb son of Jephunneh He will see it and I will give him and his descendants the land on which he has set foot because he followed the LORD wholeheartedly
verses.literalPt: exceto Calebe, filho de Jefoné. Ele a verá; e a terra que pisou, dá-la-ei a ele e a seus filhos, pois perseverou em seguir a Jeová.

verses.original: גַּם־ בִּי֙ הִתְאַנַּ֣ף יְהוָ֔ה בִּגְלַלְכֶ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר גַּם־ אַתָּ֖ה לֹא־ תָבֹ֥א שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: gam- bî hiṯ·’an·nap̄ Yah·weh biḡ·lal·ḵem lê·mōr gam- ’at·tāh lō- ṯā·ḇō šām
verses.literal: The LORD was also angry . . . with me on your account and He said Not even you shall enter the land
verses.literalPt: Também contra mim se irou Jeová por causa de vós, dizendo: Igualmente tu lá não entrarás.

verses.original: יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ בִּן נוּן֙ הָעֹמֵ֣ד לְפָנֶ֔יךָ ה֖וּא יָ֣בֹא שָׁ֑מָּה אֹת֣וֹ חַזֵּ֔ק כִּי־ ה֖וּא יַנְחִלֶ֥נָּה אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin nūn hā·‘ō·mêḏ lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā hū yā·ḇō šām·māh ’ō·ṯōw ḥaz·zêq kî- hū yan·ḥi·len·nāh ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Joshua son of Nun who stands before you will enter it Encourage him for he will enable Israel to inherit the land
verses.literalPt: Josué, filho de Num, que te serve, entrará para ali; anima-o, porque ele fará que Israel a receba por herança.

verses.original: וְטַפְּכֶם֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲמַרְתֶּ֜ם לָבַ֣ז יִהְיֶ֗ה וּ֠בְנֵיכֶם אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־ יָדְע֤וּ הַיּוֹם֙ ט֣וֹב וָרָ֔ע הֵ֖מָּה יָבֹ֣אוּ שָׁ֑מָּה וְלָהֶ֣ם אֶתְּנֶ֔נָּה וְהֵ֖ם יִירָשֽׁוּהָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṭap·pə·ḵem ’ă·šer ’ă·mar·tem lā·ḇaz yih·yeh ū·ḇə·nê·ḵem ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḏə·‘ū hay·yō·wm ṭō·wḇ wā·rā‘ hêm·māh yā·ḇō·’ū šām·māh wə·lā·hem ’et·tə·nen·nāh wə·hêm yī·rå̄·šū·hå̄
verses.literal: And the little ones you said would become captives your children who on that day did not know good from evil will enter the land that I will give them and they will possess it
verses.literalPt: Vossos pequeninos, de quem dissestes que seriam por presa, e vossos filhos, que hoje não têm conhecimento do bem nem do mal, esses lá entrarão, e a eles darei a terra, e a possuirão.

verses.original: וְאַתֶּ֖ם פְּנ֣וּ לָכֶ֑ם וּסְע֥וּ הַמִּדְבָּ֖רָה דֶּ֥רֶךְ יַם־ סֽוּף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tem pə·nū lā·ḵem ū·sə·‘ū ham·miḏ·bā·rāh de·reḵ yam- sūp̄
verses.literal: But you are to turn back and head for the wilderness along the route to the Red Sea
verses.literalPt: Porém vós voltai e parti para o deserto pelo caminho do mar Vermelho.

verses.original: וַֽתַּעֲנ֣וּ׀ וַתֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלַ֗י חָטָאנוּ֮ לַֽיהוָה֒ אֲנַ֤חְנוּ נַעֲלֶה֙ וְנִלְחַ֔מְנוּ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוָּ֖נוּ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֑ינוּ וַֽתַּחְגְּר֗וּ אִ֚ישׁ אֶת־ כְּלֵ֣י מִלְחַמְתּ֔וֹ וַתָּהִ֖ינוּ לַעֲלֹ֥ת הָהָֽרָה׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘ă·nū wat·tō·mə·rū ’ê·lay ḥā·ṭā·nū Yah·weh ’ă·naḥ·nū na·‘ă·leh wə·nil·ḥam·nū kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wā·nū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū wat·taḥ·gə·rū ’îš ’eṯ- kə·lê mil·ḥam·tōw wat·tā·hî·nū la·‘ă·lōṯ hā·hā·rāh
verses.literal: We have sinned against the LORD you replied . . . . . . We will go up and fight as the LORD our God has commanded us Then each of you put on his weapons of war thinking it easy to go up into the hill country
verses.literalPt: Então, me respondestes: Pecamos contra Jeová; nós subiremos e pelejaremos, de acordo com tudo o que Jeová, nosso Deus, nos ordenou. Vós vos armastes, cada um dos seus instrumentos de guerra, e vos mostrastes temerários subindo ao monte.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלַ֗י אֱמֹ֤ר לָהֶם֙ לֹ֤א תַֽעֲלוּ֙ וְלֹא־ תִלָּ֣חֲמ֔וּ כִּ֥י אֵינֶ֖נִּי בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְלֹא֙ תִּנָּֽגְפ֔וּ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹיְבֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’ê·lay ’ĕ·mōr lā·hem lō ṯa·‘ă·lū wə·lō- ṯil·lā·ḥă·mū kî ’ê·nen·nî bə·qir·bə·ḵem wə·lō tin·nā·ḡə·p̄ū lip̄·nê ’ō·yə·ḇê·ḵem
verses.literal: But the LORD said to me Tell them not to go up and fight for I am not with you to keep you from defeat by your enemies
verses.literalPt: Disse-me Jeová: Dize-lhes: Não subais, nem pelejeis, porque não estou no meio de vós; para que não sejais feridos diante dos vossos inimigos.

verses.original: וָאֲדַבֵּ֥ר אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם וְלֹ֣א שְׁמַעְתֶּ֑ם וַתַּמְרוּ֙ אֶת־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַתָּזִ֖דוּ וַתַּעֲל֥וּ הָהָֽרָה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ă·ḏab·bêr ’ă·lê·ḵem wə·lō šə·ma‘·tem wat·tam·rū ’eṯ- pî Yah·weh wat·tā·zi·ḏū wat·ta·‘ă·lū hā·hā·rāh
verses.literal: So I spoke to you but you would not listen You rebelled against the command of the LORD and presumptuously went up into the hill country
verses.literalPt: Assim vos falei, e não escutastes; antes, rebelastes contra a ordem de Jeová, fostes presunçosos e subistes ao monte.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֨א הָאֱמֹרִ֜י הַיֹּשֵׁ֨ב בָּהָ֤ר הַהוּא֙ לִקְרַאתְכֶ֔ם וַיִּרְדְּפ֣וּ אֶתְכֶ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ינָה הַדְּבֹרִ֑ים וַֽיַּכְּת֥וּ אֶתְכֶ֛ם בְּשֵׂעִ֖יר עַד־ חָרְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê hā·’ĕ·mō·rî hay·yō·šêḇ bā·hār ha·hū liq·raṯ·ḵem way·yir·də·p̄ū ’eṯ·ḵem ka·’ă·šer ta·‘ă·śe·nāh had·də·ḇō·rîm way·yak·kə·ṯū ’eṯ·ḵem bə·śê·‘îr ‘aḏ- ḥā·rə·māh
verses.literal: Then the Amorites who lived in the hills came out against you and chased you like . . . a swarm of bees They routed you from Seir all the way to Hormah
verses.literalPt: Os amorreus, que habitavam naquele monte, saíram ao vosso encontro e vos perseguiram, como o fazem as abelhas, derrotando-vos em Seir, até Hormá.

verses.original: וַתָּשֻׁ֥בוּ וַתִּבְכּ֖וּ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְלֹֽא־ שָׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ בְּקֹ֣לְכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א הֶאֱזִ֖ין אֲלֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·šu·ḇū wat·tiḇ·kū lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·lō- šā·ma‘ Yah·weh bə·qō·lə·ḵem wə·lō he·’ĕ·zîn ’ă·lê·ḵem
verses.literal: And you returned and wept before the LORD but He would not listen to your voice or give ear to you
verses.literalPt: Tendo voltado, chorastes diante de Jeová; porém Jeová não vos ouviu a vós, nem inclinou os ouvidos a vós.

verses.original: וַתֵּשְׁב֥וּ בְקָדֵ֖שׁ יָמִ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים כַּיָּמִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשַׁבְתֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·šə·ḇū ḇə·qā·ḏêš yā·mîm rab·bîm kay·yā·mîm ’ă·šer yə·šaḇ·tem
verses.literal: For this reason you stayed in Kadesh for a long time a very long time
verses.literalPt: Assim ficastes muitos dias em Cades, segundo os dias que ali ficastes.
